verdict.rationale: Base44 offers GitHub sync for general code version control (docs-2, docs-18) which could theoretically let users track and revert changes to automation logic, but there's no dedicated feature for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back specific 'automations' (e.g., AI agents/workflows) within the platform itself. Community commentary even notes the founder pushed code daily without code reviews, undermining confidence in a built-in review/rollback discipline.
